}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a note found during [[Operation: Frontier Renewal]] and is added to its Archives, Spacetrek Observatory Files.

==Text==
A length of plain, monotone silk, embroidered with the names of the Roya lost to the Void Storm that ravaged the Spacetrek Observatory. Dhalifa's name is there as well, yet a single strand of violet thread crosses it out.
